surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
Resolve the combination of reports_root and filename to an absolute, lexically normalized path. If the path is not strictly beneath reports_root, raise ValueError. Walking from reports_root, examine each path segment introduced by filename: if any segment exists and is a symbolic link, raise ValueError, even when that link currently points to a file inside the approved root. Open the path in text mode with UTF-8 encoding, read the entire file, and return the string. Do not catch FileNotFoundError; allow it to propagate for missing ordinary files.
END_PLAN
